solution_principle: Move high-value assets under chain-specific post-quantum-gated accounts or vaults before full base-layer migration, while preserving explicit residual-risk labels for consensus, exposed-key rescue, relay, wallet, audit, and interoperability gaps.

chains.supported_claim: Native Falcon-1024 accounts are live on mainnet and supported by SDKs, AlgoKit, and Pera Wallet.
chains.boundary: Account-layer PQ authorization does not establish full-protocol PQ consensus resilience.

chains.supported_claim: QSB demonstrated a hash-based quantum-resistant storage/spend construction on Bitcoin mainnet without a consensus change.
chains.boundary: The demonstrated path is nonstandard, requires a direct miner route, and does not rescue keys already exposed before migration.

chains.supported_claim: The Qubit project reports a live mainnet PDA vault authorizing SOL and SPL withdrawals with hash-based Winternitz one-time signatures.
chains.boundary: Independent cryptographic/security audit is not established by this evidence record; base-layer transaction and consensus authentication remain classical.

chains.supported_claim: Project Eleven released Cure53-audited libqc/quantum-vault reference implementations using ERC-4337 smart accounts and validator-swappable account architecture.
chains.boundary: The released validator support described by Project Eleven is currently secp256k1; ML-DSA/SLH-DSA integration is not yet a live PQ authorization path in this reference implementation.

deployment_rule.high_value_assets: Prefer native PQ accounts where available; otherwise use independently reviewed programmable PQ vaults once chain-specific verification and recovery gates pass.
deployment_rule.classical_owner_key: Do not treat an old classical owner key as a permanent root of authority after PQ migration; where architecture permits, move value into an account/vault whose spend condition is controlled by the PQ mechanism itself.
deployment_rule.recovery: Require tested recovery and key-rotation paths, especially for stateful one-time or limited-use signature schemes.
deployment_rule.bridges_and_stablecoins: Treat bridge, issuer, upgrade, oracle, and admin authorities as separate migration dependencies even when holder accounts are PQ-gated.
deployment_rule.consensus: Never label application/account-layer protection as full-chain PQ security while validator/consensus authentication remains classical.

prohibited_inferences: Application-layer or account-layer PQ protection does not make a blockchain fully quantum-safe.
Project-reported mainnet deployment is not independent security validation.
Audited crypto-agile substrate is not the same as a live post-quantum validator.
A vault path that protects concealed keys does not automatically rescue already-exposed classical keys.
No production quantum key break or Q-day is established by this record.
